senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to press, twist,] to wrong, esp. to withhold what is due to a fellowman; to deny a debt.
units: B. Mets. 111ᵃ (ref. to Lev. V, 21) או עשק כתיב שעֲשָׁקוֹ כבר we read, ‘or if he have withheld’, which means that he had wronged him ere this (when he denied his indebtedness).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:6">Koh. R. to IV, 6</cite> <he>טוב … גוזל וחומס ועוֹשֵׁק ועושה וכ׳</he> better is he who does a little good with what is his own, than he who robs and does violence and oppresses, and does much good with what belongs to others.

<cite ref="Sukkah 29b:2">Succ. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>עוֹשְׁקֵי שכר שכיר</he> those who withhold the hired man’s wages, different from <he>כובשי וכ׳</he> (v. <cite ref="K00081"><he>כָּבַשׁ</he></cite>) who defer paying &c.; a. e.
